meta.name: keyed-dynamic-universe
meta.description: Maintain an online covariance over named series whose set changes over time (e.g. assets entering and leaving). Use when observations arrive as dicts keyed by name rather than fixed-length vectors. Wraps precise's keyed / FixedUniverse / DynamicUniverse adapters.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时计算动态资产组合的在线协方差
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果资产列表不断变化且需要实时协方差矩阵
copy.tagline_en: Compute live covariance for dynamic asset sets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your asset universe changes frequently and you need real-time covariance

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能维护一个随名称集合变化而更新的协方差矩阵。它接受以字典形式（如 {"BTC":0.01}）输入的观测，自动处理新名称加入或旧名称退出，并输出一个按名称索引的协方差矩阵。
howto.when: 当你以字典形式（keyed dict）提供观测数据，例如金融资产收益率序列，且名称集合可能随时间变化时触发。

say.note: 返回当前协方差矩阵中对应项

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude maintains a covariance matrix over a set of named series that can change over time. It accepts observations as dicts keyed by name (e.g., {"BTC":0.01}), automatically handles new keys entering or leaving, and outputs a key-indexed covariance matrix.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide observations as keyed dicts (e.g., asset returns) where the set of keys may change over time, such as financial data streams.

say_en.text: Compute the covariance between BTC and ETH
say_en.note: Returns the corresponding entry in the current covariance matrix
